body:
Okay, so I've read many submissions on how to pass a piss test. Some have good information, flushing with lots of fluids, vitamin supplements, etc, etc. Some not so good that are too ridiculous to even mention. I personally have used a nearly fail proof method but fair warning, it is not for the faint of heart or squeamish. This is a drastic times call for drastic measures method. That said it is fairly straightforward.
First one needs to obtain a catheter. These can be purchased from medical supplies stores. In some areas they require a prescription for purchase. If this is the case they are readily available online without a prescription. One will also need a syringe, 50cc or larger will work fine. Now the fucked up part. One will need clean urine from either a synthetic supplier or a trusted friend or significant other. When I say trusted I not only mean one needs to trust that it is free of drugs but one must also consider the fact that STD's could also be passed do to the fact one will be using the syringe and catheter to fill their bladder with the clean urine. One should make sure to drink lots of fluids and pee just before going into the testing facility. Now insert catheter, warning if the bladder is not completely empty any remaining urine is going to drain into the catheter. One warms the syringe with clean urine within a few degrees of body temp. Now one takes the syringe and insert into end of catheter and inject into the bladder, remove quickly in one motion. One is now ready to pass test. One should get in as quickly as possible. If one has high concentrations of drugs or drug metabolites in their system a prolonged wait could put enough into the bladder to fail a test.
